summary: Frontend-only verification of Settings left-rail redesign, Home screen row-reorder/hide panel, and rebuilt native-input Search. All acceptance criteria PASS after allowing ~8s for TMDB search to resolve. The ?e2e=1 sessionStorage hook works — /settings no longer bounces after seeding profile.

integration_issues.issue: First /api/tmdb/search call typically takes ~7-8s to resolve in this preview pod (results-column stays on 'Searching…' until then). Previously fine ~4s. Recents / focus-first-result / search-empty all depend on that promise resolving, so short-wait tests can flap. Not a code bug — a backend latency observation.

critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx is 1829 lines — still growing. Splitting HomeRowsPanel, ThemeSection, PlaybackSection, ViewingPreferenceSection, BackupSection into own files under /pages/settings/* would help maintainability (threshold >700).

The review-request expectation 'Click home-row-studios-up twice → studios is row 01' is off by one: default order puts studios at index 3, so 3 up-clicks are needed to reach row 01. Two clicks correctly land it at row 02. Code (moveHomeRow in homeRows.js) is behaving correctly — the spec sentence is inaccurate.

Search results/recents completion depends on /api/tmdb/search which can take ~8s cold. Consider surfacing a lightweight skeleton for suggestions/results or a client-side cache warmer to keep first-search feel snappy on TV.

context_for_next_testing_agent: ?e2e=1 sessionStorage hook works reliably — always start with page.goto(BASE + '/?e2e=1'). Login uses placeholder-based inputs: page.get_by_placeholder('Enter your username').fill(...) then 'Enter your password' then get_by_role('button', name='Sign in'). After login, seed onnowtv-profiles-v1:testuser + onnowtv-active-profile-v1:testuser (and plain keys for legacy). Set vesper-onboarding-seen-v1 and onnowtv-whatsnew-seen-v1='1.4.0'. Settings section default is 'theme', not 'home' — always click settings-nav-home before asserting home-rows-panel. The Settings page is tall; home-rows-reset sits below the fold on 1080p — scroll it into view before clicking (page.evaluate scrollIntoView). Search results/suggestions can take up to 8s cold in this preview pod, so wait ≥8s after pressing Enter before checking recents/empty state.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — no functional defects found. The single misleading item in the review request ('studios-up twice → row 01') is a spec arithmetic slip: studios is default row 04, so exactly 3 up-clicks are needed to reach row 01; two clicks correctly places it at row 02. moveHomeRow() logic in /app/frontend/src/lib/homeRows.js is correct.
